chunks.title: Typhoid Fever — Empiric Treatment
chunks.chunk_text: Enteric fever in Nepal: rising fluoroquinolone resistance. Ceftriaxone 1g IV/IM daily or azithromycin 500mg OD x7 days for uncomplicated cases. Do not use antipyretics that mask response in undifferentiated fever — confirm with blood culture when possible. Hydration and ORS essential.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: नेपालमा टाइफाइड: सिप्रोफ्लोक्सासिन प्रतिरोध बढ्दो। सेफ्ट्रियाक्सोन वा एजिथ्रोमाइसिन। रगत संस्कृति जाँच गर्नुहोस्।

chunks.title: Dengue — Outpatient Management
chunks.chunk_text: Dengue warning signs: abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, mucosal bleed, lethargy, hepatomegaly, rising hematocrit with falling platelets. AVOID NSAIDs and aspirin — use paracetamol only. Monitor platelets and hematocrit daily in warning phase. IV crystalloid if plasma leakage.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: डेङ्गु चेतावनी: पेट दुखाइ, बान्ता, रक्तश्राव। एस्पिरिन र आइबुप्रोफेन नदिनुहोस्। प्यारासिटामोल मात्र।

chunks.title: TB DOTS — Intensive Phase
chunks.chunk_text: Standard Nepal DOTS new case regimen: 2HRZE/4HR (2 months isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide, ethambutol; then 4 months isoniazid, rifampicin). Directly observed therapy. Monitor for hepatitis: anorexia, jaundice, tender hepatomegaly. Pyridoxine 25mg with isoniazid.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: नेपाल DOTS: २ महिना HRZE, ४ महिना HR। पिरिडोक्सिन साथमा।

chunks.title: Snakebite — First Hour
chunks.chunk_text: Do not incise, suck, or apply tourniquet. Immobilize limb at heart level. 20-minute whole blood clotting test (20WBCT). Neurotoxic signs: ptosis, respiratory weakness. Hemotoxic: bleeding gums, hematuria. Give polyvalent antivenom only if envenomation signs — not prophylactically. Adrenaline ready for anaphylaxis.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: घाउ काट्नुहोस् होइन। अंग स्थिर राख्नुहोस्। विषाक्त लक्षण भए मात्र एन्टिभेनम।

chunks.title: Acute Diarrhea — IMCI
chunks.chunk_text: Assess dehydration plan A/B/C. Plan A: ORS after each stool, continue feeding. Plan B: 75ml/kg ORS over 4h in clinic. Plan C: IV Ringer's lactate 100ml/kg. Zinc 20mg x10 days for children >6 months. No routine antibiotics except dysentery (ciprofloxacin) or cholera context.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: ORS र जिंक। योजना A/B/C अनुसार पुनःजलयोजन।

chunks.title: Malaria — Terai Endemic
chunks.chunk_text: Confirm with RDT before treatment. P. falciparum: artemether-lumefantrine weight-based x3 days. P. vivax: chloroquine plus primaquine for radical cure (G6PD test first). Uncomplicated malaria does not require hospitalization. Severe malaria: IV artesunate.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: RDT पुष्टि पछि उपचार। भिवाक्समा प्रिमाक्विन — G6PD जाँच।

chunks.title: Hypertension — First Line Nepal OPD
chunks.chunk_text: Start lifestyle counseling: salt reduction, physical activity. First-line pharmacotherapy: amlodipine 5mg OD or enalapril 5mg OD (not in pregnancy). Target <140/90 general; <130/80 if diabetes or CKD. Monthly titration. Combine agents if needed.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: पहिलो लाइन: एम्लोडिपिन वा एनालाप्रिल। गर्भवतीमा ACE inhibitor निषेध।

chunks.title: Type 2 Diabetes — Initial Therapy
chunks.chunk_text: Metformin 500mg BD with meals if eGFR adequate. Counsel diet and exercise. Sulfonylurea (glibenclamide) if metformin contraindicated or unaffordable — warn hypoglycemia. HbA1c target <7% if safely achievable. Annual foot exam and urine albumin.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: मेटफर्मिन पहिलो। ग्लिबेन्क्लामाइड सस्तो विकल्प — hypoglycemia चेतावनी।

chunks.title: Asthma — OPD Step Therapy
chunks.chunk_text: Rescue: salbutamol inhaler 2 puffs PRN. Controller if symptoms >2x/week: low-dose beclomethasone 200mcg BD. Spacer improves deposition. Avoid smoke and biomass exposure — major trigger in Nepal households.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: सालबुटामोल रेस्क्यू। नियमित बेक्लोमेटासोन यदि बारम्बार लक्षण।

chunks.title: Pregnancy — Iron Folic Acid
chunks.chunk_text: Iron 60mg elemental + folic acid 400mcg daily throughout pregnancy. Calcium 1g daily second trimester onward. Misoprostol 600mcg sublingual for PPH at facility level. Magnesium sulfate for eclampsia per loading + maintenance protocol.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: आयरन-फोलिक दैनिक। PPH मा मिसोप्रोस्टोल। एक्लेम्प्सियामा म्याग्नेसियम।

chunks.title: Altitude Illness — Trekking Medicine
chunks.chunk_text: Acute mountain sickness: stop ascent, rest, acetazolamide 250mg BD. HACE: dexamethasone 8mg stat then 4mg q6h + immediate descent. HAPE: descent, nifedipine, supplemental O2. Do not ascend with symptoms.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: लक्षण भए उकालो नचढ्नुहोस्। HACE मा डेक्सामेथासोन र तुरुन्त ओर्लनुहोस्।

chunks.title: Anaphylaxis — Emergency
chunks.chunk_text: IM adrenaline 0.5mg (1:1000) lateral thigh — first and most important treatment. Repeat q5-15min. Supine with legs elevated. IV fluids. Adjunct: chlorpheniramine, hydrocortisone. Observe 4-6 hours minimum.

chunks.title: Helminthiasis — Mass Drug Admin
chunks.chunk_text: Albendazole 400mg single dose for soil-transmitted helminths in children >2 years and adults. School-based MDA twice yearly in endemic districts. Repeat in 6 months if heavy infection.

chunks.title: H. pylori — Triple Therapy
chunks.chunk_text: First-line where available: amoxicillin 1g BD + clarithromycin 500mg BD + PPI BD x14 days. If clarithromycin unavailable in rural Nepal: metronidazole + amoxicillin + PPI. Confirm eradication if recurrent ulcer.

chunks.title: Epilepsy — Rural First Line
chunks.chunk_text: Phenobarbitone 60mg HS cost-effective first line in resource-limited settings. Carbamazepine if partial seizures. Status epilepticus: diazepam 0.2mg/kg IV/rectal, repeat x1. Avoid sudden withdrawal.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: फिनोबार्बिटोन गाउँमा सस्तो। Status मा डायाजेपाम।

chunks.title: Burns — Primary Care
chunks.chunk_text: Cool running water 20 minutes within 3 hours. No ice, no toothpaste. TBSA rule of nines. Refer if >10% TBSA partial thickness, any full thickness face/hands/genitalia, circumferential, or inhalational injury.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: चिसो पानी २० मिनेट। १०% भन्दा बढी भ면 रेफर।

chunks.title: IMCI — Fever Without Focus
chunks.chunk_text: In malaria endemic Terai: RDT all fevers. In non-endemic hills: assess duration. <7 days viral likely — paracetamol, fluids, return if worsening. Consider typhoid if sustained fever >3 days with relative bradycardia. UTI in infants — urine dipstick.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: तेराईमा RDT। ३ दिन भन्दा बढी ज्वरो — टाइफाइड सोच्नुहोस्।

chunks.title: Antibiotic Stewardship — Rural OPD
chunks.chunk_text: Do not use antibiotics for viral URTI. Amoxicillin first-line for bacterial pneumonia and otitis. Avoid fluoroquinolones as first-line. Complete prescribed course. Educate patients — antibiotic misuse drives resistance in South Asia.
chunks.chunk_text_ne: भाइरल संक्रमणमा एन्टिबायोटिक होइन। पूरा कोर्स पूरा गर्नुहोस्।
